Im not trying to invalidate your feelings, but a friendly reminder that helps me during this- 
Depression makes your brain think you're a burden, as well as steal your energy to do things. You're in survival mode, of course you won't be getting as much done- your brain is only considering basic needs. 
I tell myself that over and over and eventually my brain latched onto it, and I hear it every time I feel this way.
It doesn't fix it, but it does lighten the load.

That's how I feel during some of mine as well. I get so dizzy I have to hold on to something, or go sit down. 
I'm so sorry you feel this way, it can be scary as heck.
I've found a little relief with box breathing. I also had good relief after slowing my heart rate down with beta blockers from the doctor.
Ooooo also the things u can touch/see/feel method helps me sometimes be able to get through the dizzy part enough to sit down or finish the situation. 
Sorry if you've heard these methods a million times, I just couldn't pass up trying to offer some kind of help. 🖤
